mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.3% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where UNRATE falls below 3.3%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units signals strong household demand and rising consumer confidence, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods with HOUST above 1.4 million, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 102.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.2% and FEDFUNDS above 4.3% signal persistent inflation and a commitment to restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity risk premiums and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 3.2 and FEDFUNDS > 4.3, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 3.4% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k indicates a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE < 3.4 and PAYEMS > 200, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 695 billion dollars, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS > 695 and GDPC1 > 2.0, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05).
